evals.prompt: Tạo cho tôi một skill mới tên là docker-compose-runner để tự động tạo file docker-compose.yml và khởi chạy container
evals.expected_output: A complete skill directory named docker-compose-runner with valid SKILL.md, appropriate frontmatter, and scaffolding
assertions: The generated directory name is docker-compose-runner
The SKILL.md contains valid YAML frontmatter with name and description
The name field does not contain uppercase letters or consecutive hyphens
The description specifies when the agent should activate the skill

evals.prompt: Create an agent skill for reviewing pull requests according to OWASP security guidelines
evals.expected_output: A skill named security-pr-reviewer or similar with kebab-case, structured instructions, and reference files
assertions: The skill name adheres to kebab-case (max 64 characters)
The SKILL.md body contains structured step-by-step workflow
The file length is under 500 lines
